name: HiKOKI / Metabo HPT
legalEntityNote: HiKOKI is Koki Holdings' international power-tool brand; Metabo HPT is the North American brand route operated by Koki Holdings America. Metabo is a distinct Koki Holdings brand and has its own separate World Clean Biz page boundary. Regional branding does not establish a common seller, factory, importer or warranty entity for every SKU.
headline: HiKOKI and Metabo HPT ownership, regional brand roles and Multi Volt systems
description: A source-backed profile of Koki Holdings' HiKOKI and Metabo HPT regional brand structure, Multi Volt platform and buyer checks that keep them separate from Metabo.
metaDescription: HiKOKI and Metabo HPT profile: Koki Holdings ownership, regional branding, Multi Volt tools, channels, warranties and buyer checks.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is an independent industry publication and is not affiliated with Koki Holdings, HiKOKI, Metabo HPT or Metabo. HiKOKI/Metabo HPT and Metabo share Koki Holdings ownership but remain separate brands and product routes.
headquarters: Tokyo, Japan (Koki Holdings); regional commercial entities vary
founded: 1948 Hitachi Koki heritage; HiKOKI brand introduced in 2018

contentVisuals.caption: Koki Holdings owns three distinct brand routes: HiKOKI internationally, Metabo HPT in North America and Metabo as a separate German-origin brand.

contentVisuals.alt: HiKOKI and Metabo HPT regional brand boundary
contentVisuals.caption: A shared parent does not make HiKOKI, Metabo HPT and Metabo products, batteries or service obligations interchangeable.

ownership.summary: Koki Holdings' official corporate history identifies HiKOKI, Metabo HPT and Metabo as brands owned by the company. HiKOKI is the international brand, while Metabo HPT is the North American market brand; Metabo remains a separate brand rather than an alias for either one.

productPortfolio.name: Multi Volt cordless tools
productPortfolio.positioning: The high-voltage cordless platform supports professional drilling, fastening, cutting and trade applications.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Verify whether the exact battery, tool and charger are offered under HiKOKI or Metabo HPT in the destination market.

productPortfolio.name: Corded tools, nailers and air tools
productPortfolio.positioning: The brand range includes traditional corded and pneumatic categories alongside cordless products.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Match regional voltage, fittings, safety approvals and service support.

productPortfolio.name: Outdoor and specialty products
productPortfolio.positioning: Portfolio extensions vary by region and channel under the HiKOKI or Metabo HPT mark.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Do not infer a universal assortment from another country website or brand name.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Koki Holdings' history establishes brand ownership and regional brand evolution, not a model-by-model factory allocation.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Use dated model labels, compliance files and shipment documents to identify manufacturer and origin.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Metabo HPT identifies Koki Holdings America as its U.S./Canada operating company.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not treat the regional operator as manufacturer or guarantor outside its stated market.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The 2025 North American integration announcement concerns brand presentation and continued service, not universal product interchangeability.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm the exact product, pack, repair and warranty route after the branding transition.

marketsChannels.evidence: Metabo HPT describes itself as the North American brand for the HiKOKI international power-tool business.
marketsChannels.scope: United States and Canada brand route
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Use the local Metabo HPT entity and authorized dealer information for North American purchases.

marketsChannels.evidence: Koki Holdings operates HiKOKI as an international brand, with regional product and support structures.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Verify current seller, importer and warranty party in the target country.

marketsChannels.evidence: Koki's 2025 North American announcement says Metabo and Metabo HPT product service, repairs and parts would continue during the branding transition.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Obtain current written confirmation for legacy-product warranty and parts eligibility.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: HiKOKI/Metabo HPT brings a regional-brand model to a professional cordless and pneumatic tool offer. The core buyer risk is naming confusion: shared Koki Holdings ownership does not make HiKOKI, Metabo HPT and Metabo the same brand, product platform or warranty route.

developments.summary: Koki Group announced that Metabo North America would transition to Metabo HPT in phases, with service and parts continuity stated for existing customers.
